name: scan-code
description: A scan area containing three QR position markers and a data block.
useCase: Scan a QR code with a camera.
misuse: Use scan-barcode for a linear barcode or code for programming syntax.

16.reason: Three solid position markers retain the QR layout without tiny enclosed counters. The data block and scanning corners stay separate at text size.

24.reason: Three square finders retain open counters, while the shorter scanning corners leave room for the complete QR layout and separate data block.
